correctness.rationale: For each strict generic band, the cross-polytope base (n0,k0) has the correct sphere dimension. Its natural reflection is the signed coordinate permutation with determinant (-1)^(ell+1). The maps j->Nj/n and j->Nj/n0 are cyclic homomorphisms into the same regular cycle and are reflection-equivariant. Adamaszek–Adams Prop.4.9 makes them top integral homology isomorphisms; reflection degrees therefore agree. Contiguity of identity and one-step rotation into K_{N,K+1}, together with Prop.4.9, forces each rotation degree +1. Rational transfer after barycentric subdivision proves the stated quotient homology. A 441-case signed Lefschetz verifier corroborates the formula but does not prove infinitely many cases. Singular ratios and integral quotient homology remain unproved.

The new proof supplies a common-refinement diagram that is exactly reflection equivariant and a contiguity argument for rotations.

originality.rationale: The 2011 sphere classification is nonequivariant, and the precise analogous 2014 dihedral character concerns circular-arc nerve complexes. The 2014 Rips-to-nerve homotopy equivalence on differing vertex counts does not intertwine standard dihedral generators, so it cannot directly imply the integral Rips character. The 2015 cyclic-map theorem supports the novel equivariant comparison. Relevant term and equivalence searches did not reveal a directly covering Rips statement; residual bibliographic risk is acknowledged.
residual_risks: A separately published or unindexed equivariant refinement of the 2014 Rips/nerve equivalence may contain the same character.
